answer: Cosignatures are collected in lagoon, verified in ridge, and wander names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 21 submissions per epoch. A 473 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
